title: Volume of the unit ball: ω_n = π^{n/2}/Γ(n/2+1) for all n ≥ 0
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, the contract's ω_n = unitBallVolume n is the Lebesgue measure of the open unit ball of ℝ^n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), so ω_0 = 1. It satisfies ω_n = π^{n/2}/Γ(n/2 + 1). Here n/2 is the real number (n:ℝ)/2, the power is the real power, and the right side is taken in [0, ∞] via ENNReal.ofReal.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, unitBallVolume n = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) / Real.Gamma ((n : ℝ) / 2 + 1))
